scope: Availability of additional real browser engines for main-site and Devnet smoke checks
installationPolicy: One official installer invocation per missing engine, connection timeout 12000 ms, overall command cap 50 seconds. No repeated optional installs after failure.

engines.result: Official CDN request timed out; installer switched to its Microsoft mirror, then failed with Unable to update lock within the stale threshold. No Firefox executable was installed.

Official CDN request timed out; the official Microsoft mirror downloaded WebKit successfully. Installer later failed updating its lock during the FFmpeg step. A direct headless launch of the downloaded WebKit executable failed because libgstreamer-1.0.so.0 is unavailable.

coverageLimit: Chromium viewport and touch emulation must not be reported as actual Firefox, Safari, iOS, Android wallet-app, or physical-device coverage. Neither additional engine completed a page test in this environment.
